verdicts.label: FALSE
verdicts.what_is_true_en: There is no scientific evidence that drinking hot water with lemon juice can destroy the coronavirus or cure COVID-19. Health organizations state that this is a widely circulated piece of misinformation.
verdicts.reasoning_en: A large body of evidence from TIER_1 fact-checking organizations, including Snopes, AP News, FactCheck.org, and AFP Fact Check, explicitly debunks the claim. These sources, published in 2020, state there is no scientific evidence to support the idea that lemon and hot water can cure or prevent COVID-19. Medical and news sources corroborate this, describing the claim as a myth and misinformation that circulated during the pandemic. No evidence was found to support the claim.
